purpose: Define required bounds for dynamic canonical and runtime operations so recursion, expansion, queueing, retries, traversal and execution cannot become unbounded.

topics.name: Bounded Operation
topics.purpose: Define required bounds for dynamic canonical and runtime operations so recursion, expansion, queueing, retries, traversal and execution cannot become unbounded.

semantics.rule: Every dynamic operation declares or inherits applicable finite bounds.
semantics.reader_rule: Canonical recursive traversal uses visited sets and bounded resource behavior without truncating semantics silently.
semantics.failure_rule: Exceeded bounds produce visible structured errors; they do not silently return partial semantics as complete.
semantics.cleanup_rule: Bound failure releases acquired runtime slots/gates/resources.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant meaning is explicit structured canonical data and is not reconstructed by hidden heuristics.

hard_gates.condition: dynamic operation has no applicable finite bound
partial/truncated result is reported as complete canonical meaning
timeout or limit failure leaves runtime gate/resource active

references.purpose: Bound failures are visible structured errors.
Bounded runtime is a Core invariant.
